## Runs 6–7 — spot-check read before the stacking fan

Raw signed Rxx, measured drain current, leakage and temperature appear first, followed by FFT stability scans. Both runs completed without clipping (Rxx extrema −33…530 Ω electron, −0.4…587 Ω hole against 5 kΩ full scale); drain current remains 9.81–9.94 nA and |gate current| <0.22 nA. Only B_1−B_2 is wired: no separately resolved spatial stacking verdict is available.

Run 6 at n_A=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D_A≈0 shows candidate spectral groups near 7.3, 14.7, 22.2 and 29.5 T (window-dependent estimates), versus F_L=33.09 T on the geometry scale. These near-integer relationships do **not** establish four pockets; harmonics, sum/difference mixing and the second CNP region remain confounds. Run 7 at −1.2×10¹² has stronger oscillations near 4–7 T and 12.4 T, but lower |n| places the two tetralayer bands close together. Neither trace yet supports a stacking verdict. Positive-field-only measurements cannot remove odd-in-B pickup by symmetrization.

The default electron `sdh_onset` is censored at 0.30 T. Restricting its background fit to B≤3 T gives 1.30 T for degrees 3 and 5 (the ~7 T tone is marginal); B≤4 T gives 1.03–1.38 T depending on background degree. This is an extraction fork, not a precisely measured 0.30 T onset. The original 50 mT grid below 1 T also fails fastest-tone Nyquist there. A short, adequately sampled low-field repeat must resolve the onset before the expensive fan is frozen (`landau-fan` step 1). The electron side remains the design target because it reaches the discriminating +2–3×10¹² regime; the hole gate limit is −1.27×10¹².

Absolute density retains the geometry prior. The secondary ridge in run 5 implies a density offset and possibly a different capacitance ratio, so extra branches cannot be assigned to domains at a common n without testing that calibration. Next: low-field grid-change check at the shared +3.2 density, then one cost-floored fan and both tetralayer/trilayer forward overlays.

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, SdhOnsetError
out = Path('hera_scratch')
results={}
for rid, n in [(6,3.2),(7,-1.2)]:
 r=open_run(f'data/{rid}')
 ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
 B=r.col('magnet_field'); I=r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain
 R=r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain/I
 idx=np.argsort(B); B=B[idx]; R=R[idx]
 fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(11,7))
 ax[0,0].plot(B,R); ax[0,0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='signed Rxx (ohm)',title=f'Raw run {rid}, n={n:+.1f}, D=0')
 ax[0,1].plot(r.col('magnet_field'),I*1e9); ax[0,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='drain current (nA)')
 ax[1,0].plot(r.col('magnet_field'),r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')*1e12,label='TG'); ax[1,0].plot(r.col('magnet_field'),r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')*1e12,label='BG');ax[1,0].legend();ax[1,0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='gate current (pA)')
 ax[1,1].plot(r.col('magnet_field'),r.col('T_sample'));ax[1,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='sample T (K)')
 fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(out/f'spot_{rid}_raw.png');plt.show()
 print('RUN',rid,'interrupted',r.interrupted,'R',R.min(),R.max(),'duration_min',np.ptp(r.col('time'))/60,'median_dt',np.median(np.diff(r.col('time'))))
 try:
  on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000)
  print(on.summary()); results[str(rid)]={'onset':float(on.onset_b),'summary':on.summary()}
 except SdhOnsetError as e:
  print('ONSET ERROR',str(e));results[str(rid)]={'error':str(e)};continue
 fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4))
 for lo in [on.onset_b,max(on.onset_b,1),max(on.onset_b,1.5),max(on.onset_b,2)]:
  for deg in [3,5]:
   f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),bg_degree=deg,nfft=4096,log=False)
   pk,_=find_peaks(sp[0]);pk=sorted([p for p in pk if 3<f[p]<60],key=lambda p:-sp[0,p])[:5]
   print('FFT',rid,'lo',round(lo,3),'degree',deg,[(round(float(f[p]),2),round(float(sp[0,p]),3)) for p in pk])
   ax.plot(f,sp[0],label=f'B>{lo:.2f}, degree={deg}')
 ax.axvline(10.33916924*abs(n),color='k',ls='--',label='F_L geometry prior')
 ax.set(xlim=(0,60),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='FFT amplitude',title=f'Run {rid}: extraction stability (positive B only; no even-B symmetrization)');ax.legend(fontsize=7)
 fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(out/f'spot_{rid}_fft.png');plt.show()
json.dump(results,open(out/'spot_results.json','w'),indent=2)
# measured gate-map acquisition cost, excluding row flyback
r=open_run('data/5');dt=np.diff(r.col('time'));print('RUN5 dt percentiles',np.percentile(dt,[10,50,90,99]),'duration_min',np.ptp(r.col('time'))/60)

## HERA — resolve the electron onset before the Landau fan

> **05:22** · Electron onset check: n=+3.2e12 D=0, B 1.8->0.2 T, 446 uniform-1/B points, sr1 10uV, base T · **ETA ~06:17** (≈55 min)

`sdh-spot-check`, in the governing `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` arc: run 6's full-record onset is censored and changes under a restricted background fit, so it cannot yet set the cost floor of a long fan. Repeat its exact +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0 gate point with uniform-1/B sampling and improved sensitivity; compare raw traces before accepting an onset. This covers only 0.2–1.8 T because run 6 already covers the upper field range; a complete 0.2–10 T repeat would add at least 60 minutes of traversal without resolving this low-field question.

446 points give Δ(1/B)=0.00999 T⁻¹: >3 points per 33.09 T Luttinger period, and >2 even with +20% scale and the secondary-region density offset. Fixed sr1 10 µV = 1 kΩ FS (run 6 remains below 60 Ω here); the blocking magnet's ≥3 s settle preserves 10τ at the recorded 0.3 s/24 dB settings. Initial 0→1.8 T positioning costs 13.1 minutes; measured 1.8→0.2 T costs an 11.7 minute ramp floor plus 446×3.1 s overhead (run 6: 7.46 s/10 mT point minus 4.38 s bare ramp), about 48 minutes before a 10% margin and setup. Endpoint 0.2 T leaves the magnet below the eventual upward fan.

Preconditions print and assert the restored state, exact validators, heater state, live thermometry, bias and acquisition pacing. First checkpoint: first 25 points for rails, leakage, current and temperature; then every ~10 minutes and at completion. Stop on leakage >1 nA or clipping, and re-read actual state before another move. On this VTI an interrupt does not stop an in-flight supply ramp; operator hardware intervention owns that case. The fan's final B floor and row count follow this onset result, not the ambiguous old fit.

# sdh-spot-check: resolve run-6 censored onset before committing the fan.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
# Preconditions first; all are reads, no safety/pacing edits.
for name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_T,_Tv,_B,_Si=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field(),k_si()
print(f'Expected base T 1.0..1.5 K, vaporizer within 0.6 K; actual {_T}, {_Tv}; expected B~0, Si=0; actual {_B}, {_Si}')
assert 1.0<=_T<=1.5 and abs(_Tv-_T)<0.6 and abs(_B)<0.05 and abs(_Si)<0.01
print('Expected heaters off / PS on / output on:',heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range(),magnet.persistent_switch_on(),magnet.output_enabled())
assert heater.sample_range()==0 and heater.vaporizer_range()==0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
for p,limits in [(k_tg.volt,(-.3,1.)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.)),(dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),(magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),(heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    actual=(p.vals._min_value,p.vals._max_value);print(p.full_name,'validator expected',limits,'actual',actual);assert actual==limits
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10 and T_SESSION_CAP==100
print('Expected drive 1 V /13.777 Hz, tau 0.3 s /24 dB, NPLC 1:',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency(),sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant(),sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope(),k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<.01
assert sr0.time_constant()==.3 and sr1.time_constant()==.3 and sr0.filter_slope()==24 and sr1.filter_slope()==24
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005 and dc205.ramp_rate==.5
assert dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1
assert magnet.settle_s>=3
# Identical rounded calibration to run 6, for a strict shared-density comparison.
_onset_cal=dict(c_tg=.002796,c_bg=.002161,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
_vt,_vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**_onset_cal)
assert -.3<=_vt<=1 and -1.3<=_vb<=2
_Bcheck=field_invB(1.8,.2,446)
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/_Bcheck)))<=.01001
sr1.sensitivity(10e-6) # 1 kOhm FS; run 6 has <60 ohm in this window, ample margin.
_mc=dict(meas_config);_mc['Si (V)']=_Si;_mc['sample_temperature:']=_T
_mc['comments']='onset/grid-change repeat of run 6: n_A=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D_A=0; B=1.8->0.2 T uniform 1/B,446 points; sr1=10uV; tau=.3s slope=24; magnet settle>=3s'
s=sweep.AsyncStation(_mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(_mc['comments'])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(_vb));s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(_vt))
interruptible_sleep(10)
# 0->1.8 T: 13.14 min bare ramp at 0.137 T/min. Blocks until reached.
magnet.field(1.8)
for p in (T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P):
    s.fp(p);s.plot('time',p)
# [time,B,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,I_X,I_P,V_X,V_P]
def onset_guard(station,data):
    vals=np.asarray(data,dtype=float)
    if not np.isfinite(vals).all() or not 1.0<=vals[2]<=1.5 or abs(vals[3]-vals[2])>=.6 or max(abs(vals[4]),abs(vals[5]))>1e-9 or abs(vals[8])>=.9*10e-6:
        print('ONSET CHECK STOP: invalid T/leakage/rail',vals)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,_Bcheck,delay=0)
print('Post-check measured B/T/gates:',magnet.field(),T_sample(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
